speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming your symptoms. To better understand the onset, can you tell me if this weakness and decreased sensation started suddenly or gradually, and have you noticed any neck pain or recent trauma?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of anabolic steroid use, alcohol consumption, and unexplained weight loss alongside this progressive right arm weakness, do you experience any numbness in the distribution of your C8 or T1 dermatomes, or have you noticed muscle wasting in the small muscles of your hand? REQUEST TEST: MRI Cervical Spine (C5-T1)

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Cervical Spine (C5-T1): Normal. No evidence of spinal cord compression, disc herniation, or nerve root impingement in the C5-T1 segments. The findings correlate with a peripheral cause for the weakness and sensory changes rather than a central neurological lesion at the cervical spine level.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful; since the cervical spine is clear, I need to distinguish between a peripheral entrapment neuropathy and a systemic cause like paraneoplastic syndrome given your weight loss. Do you have difficulty extending your wrist or fingers, and have you noticed any weakness in the left arm as well? REQUEST TEST: Nerve_Conduction_Study (Right_Ulnar_and_Radial)

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Nerve_Conduction_Study (Right_Ulnar_and_Radial): Severe motor and sensory conduction block of the right ulnar nerve at the elbow and right radial nerve at the axilla, consistent with a multifocal peripheral neuropathy.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Paraneoplastic Multifocal Motor Neuropathy (associated with underlying malignancy, likely lymphoma or lung cancer given weight loss and steroid use). Please proceed with staging workup including CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis and serum paraneoplastic antibody panel.
